rich_text.plain_text: Why We're Building This

text.content: Why We're Building This

rich_text.plain_text: Through our design sprints, customer research, and direct work with enterprise customers, we heard the same pain point over and over: workflow fragmentation. Traders spend hours every morning toggling between weather sites, market data platforms, spreadsheets, and internal tools just to build a picture of what kind of day it is. The analysis that should take 10 minutes takes two hours, and most of that time is gathering context, not making decisions.

rich_text.plain_text: Two things are driving this effort: we have emerging product-market fit with our enterprise customers, and the competitive landscape has shifted with agentic AI. We're doubling down on what's working, with some targeted tweaks.

text.content: Two things are driving this effort: we have emerging product-market fit with our enterprise customers, and the competitive landscape has shifted with agentic AI. We're doubling down on what's working, with some targeted tweaks.

rich_text.plain_text: Our enterprise engagements (NRG, BP, Gunvor) have validated that EQ's platform solves real problems for real traders. But enterprise sales cycles are long, resource-intensive, and vulnerable to single points of failure if there are skeptical users. We are targeting the hardest, most expensive place to enter a customer relationship: the top of the enterprise. A common application suite with progressive access levels changes this for our customers and for us.  An individual trader signs up and immediately gets value of workflow fragmentation relief through unified market data, probabilistic forecasts, AI-native capabilities, and full transparency into the data behind every assumption (what we call "glass box"). No enterprise sales cycle required. We build brand rapport with individual users, then provide the right hooks and carrots to encourage them deeper into our enterprise solutions. This is the tweaked GTM motion: lower friction entry, brand recognition with individual users, and natural expansion into team and enterprise contracts.

Bring your own data, forecasts, and strategies into the same unified surface, and our AI workflows seamlessly pick them up. Connect your existing pipelines through our APIs and SDKs. Our enterprise platform offering is the infrastructure that enables traders to understand markets, evaluate positions, and take action, whether EQ develops strategies for them or they develop their own.

rich_text.plain_text: What makes this approach sticky is not any single feature. It's that each layer of investment compounds. Workflow embedding gets us in (traders adopt because it replaces the 20-tab morning routine, not because we sold them a feature list). Speaking trader language from day one means zero learning curve due to exceptional UX. Co-optimization across market products (DART + CRRs + futures + gas on one platform) creates value no individual tool can replicate. And intelligence that learns, remembers, and compounds over time means a trader who's used the product for six months has a system that understands how they think. Switching means starting over.

rich_text.plain_text: This is one application suite. It starts as an individual trader's daily operating environment and scales as customers invest more: more data, more users, more automation, more integration. We use "doors" to describe natural expansion moments, not tiers or gates, because a customer can enter through any door and does not need to proceed sequentially. Each door is an "I want more" signal where the platform meets the customer where they are. There are value levers that can be controlled throughout the application to help control the funnel and GTM motion as well (usage caps, limitations on scenarios, limitations on agents, etc.).
